title: Handed Back
logline: A lorry driver finds an envelope of cash wedged in his cab after a delivery, and spends two days trying to find out whose it is instead of keeping it.
human_question: What does it cost, in the moment, to give back something no one would ever know you kept?

premise.story: A driver who finds money or valuables left behind, and the real, inconvenient effort of tracking down and returning it.
premise.place: The cab of a working vehicle, depots, phone calls, the open road.
premise.experience: A small, ordinary moral decision made in real time, with real cost attached.

concept_links.why: This is restraint in the moment (sampatta virati), arising without any prior vow, at the exact point where a wrong could be done and isn't [C024-P:L61].
This is a single moment's factors on display, not proof of a lifelong virtue; the roster present in that moment is what matters [C019-P:L49].

what_camera_could_observe: The discovery of the money or item
Phone calls and asking around to find the owner
The drive or journey to return it
The actual handover, and the driver's own account of the decision
what_must_be_real: A genuine find and a genuine return as it actually happens, not staged or re-enacted after the fact. Full consent from whoever the item belongs to.

possible_arc.turn: The envelope, or item, is found.
possible_arc.ending_open: Whether and how it is returned, and what it actually costs the driver to do it.

requirements: A real, current instance that can be filmed as it unfolds, not reconstructed afterward
Consent from both the driver and the person the item belongs to
A working freight or transport route

suggestions.name: A long-distance freight route through the dry zone
suggestions.region: e.g. the A9 or A6 highway corridor
suggestions.why: Region-level suggestion for a working transport route with real cargo and drivers.
suggestions.verify: No specific driver, route or incident has been identified or confirmed.

risks: Cannot be staged or re-enacted after the fact without falsifying the entire premise
Legal complications around lost property and its rightful owner
drop_if: No genuine, current instance can be found and filmed as it actually unfolds

connections.note: Both show restraint from a specific wrong, one in a single moment, the other as an ongoing daily practice.

unknowns: No participant, access or event has been found or confirmed. Everything above is a research direction.
